A GERMANY-BASED AI STARTUP JUST RELEASED A POWERFUL NEW AI IMAGE GENERATOR THAT'S 5X FASTER AND 7X SMALLER THAN ITS ORIGINAL MODEL.

And the best part is that its model weights are publicly available to download.

Meet P-H3-Image, a new open-weight AI image generation and editing model from Pruna AI, built by transforming MiniMax's H3 video model into a powerful image creation system.

Here's what makes this AI model a game changer:

• 5X faster: Generates images using just 8 diffusion steps instead of 50. 
• 7X smaller: Optimized from the original MiniMax H3 architecture. 
• Ultra-realistic images: Creates detailed portraits, editorial photography, and cinematic visuals. 
• 16MP resolution: Supports high-resolution image generation. 
• AI photo editing: Edit and combine images using up to 8 input pictures. 
• Smart prompting: Automatically expands simple ideas into detailed image prompts.
• Open weights: Available through Hugging Face, with Diffusers and ComfyUI support.

What makes this release especially interesting is how Pruna built it.

Instead of training an entirely new image model from scratch, the team adapted an existing video generation model to produce high-quality still images with fewer computational steps.

Pruna reports that it can generate a 4MP image in 2.6 seconds on an NVIDIA B200 GPU, although performance depends on the hardware used.

The model is free to download where permitted, but its MiniMax H3 Community License includes geographic and usage restrictions, and local generation requires substantial GPU resources.

This is another major example of how AI model optimization can make powerful creative technology more efficient and accessible.
